title: Custom Furniture Commission Process: Solid Wood Design & Crafting Guide
meta_description: Commission bespoke solid wood furniture tailored to your space. Learn the step-by-step process from dimensioning and timber selection to artisan joinery and delivery.
body_html:
Commissioning custom handcrafted solid wood furniture transforms personalized room dimensions, architectural niches, and aesthetic preferences into one-of-a-kind heirloom pieces. The success of a custom commission depends on three fundamental checkpoints: articulating your exact spatial clearance requirements, selecting the appropriate timber tone and hand-rubbed finish, and understanding the bespoke artisan workflow from initial concept consultation to white-glove crate dispatch.

WRYDECO is a US-operated furniture brand creating handcrafted natural wood furniture with master artisans in Vietnam, with bespoke statement pieces and modular designs ranging from $576.90 for architectural floating wall ledges up to $25,895.65 for monumental canopy beds and organic curved freestanding room dividers. Unlike mass-market catalog retailers with rigid sizing, our custom commission service enables homeowners, architects, and interior designers to adapt dimensions, specify organic branch silhouettes, and incorporate hand-carved details tailored specifically to their living spaces.

How does the custom furniture commission process unfold from concept to completion?

Commissioning a bespoke solid wood piece is an interactive collaborative journey that bridges digital design coordination with traditional Vietnamese hand craftsmanship. The process begins with an initial spatial consultation where you share photographs of your room, architectural sketches, floor plans, and primary design objectives with the WRYDECO design team.

Once dimensions and aesthetic directions are defined, our artisans select premium kiln-dried solid hardwood boards that exhibit complementary grain flow, natural live-edge curves, and durable density. For sculptural items like the compare specifications for Organic Curved Solid Wood Bookshelf Freestanding ($4,800.00 to $6,150.00), woodwrights hand-shape each curvilinear upright and horizontal shelf to achieve harmonious visual balance. Following joinery assembly and detailed hand sanding, multiple coats of plant-based, zero-VOC hardwax oil are hand-rubbed into the timber to nourish the wood fibers before final inspection and custom wooden crate packing.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305903767642.jpg]

Keep these four initial commission milestones in mind when planning your custom project:

  • Prepare clear room photographs showing lighting, adjoining doors, electrical outlets, and existing woodwork.
  • Define whether your primary goal is architectural display, open-plan space division, or heavy functional storage.
  • Request wood finish sample consultations to ensure harmonious coordination with your existing flooring.
  • Discuss any unique spatial obstacles such as non-standard wall angles, high baseboards, or ceiling soffits.

Which spatial measurements and architectural constraints must you define before commissioning?

Accurate measurement is the foundation of every successful custom furniture commission. Before finalizing a bespoke design, you must measure not only the primary installation zone but also the entry pathways leading into your home. A magnificent sculptural piece must comfortably navigate front doors, hallway turns, stairwells, and elevators.

When planning statement freestanding pieces like the compare specifications for Solid Wood Organic Curved Bookshelf and Room Divider ($4,800.00 to $6,150.00), measure your ceiling height across multiple floor points to account for floor unevenness. For wall-mounted installations such as the compare specifications for Solid Wood Arched Floating Two Tier Wall Shelf ($576.90 to $1,326.90), locate and mark your wall framing studs (16-inch or 24-inch on-center) to ensure internal steel mounting brackets can anchor directly into solid framing timbers.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305903505498.jpg]

Review these four measurement checkpoints before submitting your custom request:

  • Measure total ceiling height, subtracting at least 6 to 12 inches for tall freestanding shelving units.
  • Measure entry doorway width and stair landing turning radius to guarantee unboxed piece clearance.
  • Verify that standard walking corridors retain at least 36 inches of open walkway width alongside the piece.
  • Mark electrical outlets and switches on your wall elevation sketch so back panels or uprights do not cover them.

Verify these four ordering parameters before finalizing your custom design commission:

  • Confirm that your custom dimension specifications leave required breathing room from adjacent architectural elements.
  • Select your wood finish from our five verified tones (Warm Wood, Dark Warm Wood, Cool Dark Wood, Natural, Dark Walnut) or request a custom stain match.
  • Note that custom carving or laser-engraved monogramming can be specified for select bespoke shelves and casegoods.
  • Contact WRYDECO design support at support@wrydeco.com with your sketches and dimension requests for a detailed quote.

How should you select natural hardwood grain patterns and zero-VOC hardwax finishes?

Because custom furniture is designed to endure for generations, selecting the right timber characteristics and protective finish is paramount. WRYDECO builds custom furniture exclusively from solid natural hardwood, preserving distinctive grain lines, authentic growth rings, and subtle color variations that tell the story of the tree's life.

Our master artisans hand-finish each custom commission using plant-based, zero-VOC hardwax oils. These eco-friendly formulas penetrate deep into the cellular structure of the wood rather than encasing it in a cold, artificial polyurethane shell. This allows the living timber to breathe and develop a rich, luminous patina over time. Natural Finish and Warm Wood celebrate blond and honey sapwood ribbons, bringing Scandinavian warmth to organic modern interiors. Walnut and Dark Walnut finishes provide deep architectural richness that grounds expansive open rooms. Maintaining an indoor relative humidity between 40% and 60% prevents natural seasonal wood movement. Routine maintenance simply requires wiping with a soft, clean dry or lightly dampened microfiber cloth without harsh chemical sprays.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305911992410.jpg]

Follow these four care and material rules to safeguard your custom solid wood piece:

  • Choose zero-VOC Natural Finish or Warm Wood for light-filled rooms, sunrooms, and organic modern interiors.
  • Choose Walnut or Dark Walnut finishes to create bold rustic grounding against painted drywall or exposed brick.
  • Avoid commercial aerosol polishes, silicone oils, and ammonia-based window cleaners on handcrafted hardwood.
  • Place humidifiers or dehumidifiers in the room to keep indoor ambient humidity between 40% and 60%.

What delivery timelines, 6-hour modification rules, and warranty policies govern bespoke orders?

Every WRYDECO bespoke commission is individually handcrafted to order by skilled artisans, ensuring meticulous attention to structural joint integrity, grain matching, and final finish sanding. All eligible orders worldwide include complimentary standard shipping directly to your residential address. Order fulfillment follows a two-stage timeline: estimated processing and crafting takes approximately 15 to 20 business days, followed by an estimated 3 to 5 business days in transit with trusted freight carriers, resulting in a total estimated delivery window of 18 to 25 business days. Because crafting and carrier routing are dependent on hand production and customs procedures, these timelines represent careful estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.

Because each piece enters personalized production preparation shortly after checkout, customers enjoy a 6-hour Golden Window immediately following purchase. During these initial 6 hours, you can request 100% free order cancellation or modify size, finish, and address details without penalty. Once the 6-hour window expires, orders enter active workshop crafting and cannot be canceled or modified. Upon delivery, inspect packaging thoroughly; returns are accepted within 30 calendar days for items that arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect, with store-paid return freight and documentation provided. Returns for change of mind are not accepted. Every custom commission includes a 1-year limited warranty covering defects in materials and craftsmanship under normal residential use.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305913040986.jpg]

Review these four purchasing policies before placing your handcrafted furniture order:

  • Take advantage of the 6-hour Golden Window after ordering to make any final adjustments to dimensions or finish.
  • Note that complimentary standard shipping delivers to your doorstep or curbside and does not include inside carrying or assembly unless arranged.
  • Plan a two-person team or coordinate professional assembly for installation day to position the heavy solid wood components.
  • Reach out directly to support@wrydeco.com with your order number whenever you have questions or custom inquiries.

Worked example: dimensioning a custom organic curved room divider bookshelf for an open loft

Suppose you are commissioning a custom Organic Curved Solid Wood Bookshelf and Room Divider to separate a living area from a home office zone in an open-concept loft with a 10-foot (120-inch) ceiling and a 14-foot (168-inch) wide dividing threshold.

  1. Calculate functional width and walkway clearance: In a 168-inch dividing threshold, selecting a custom width of 68 inches leaves 100 inches of open floor width (168 - 68 = 100 inches). Positioning the bookshelf with 16 inches of clearance from the outer perimeter wall leaves an 84-inch main walkway (100 - 16 = 84 inches). This generous walkway allows two people to walk abreast comfortably without brushing against the shelves.
  2. Determine vertical proportion and sightlines: Selecting a 68-inch custom height places the top curved shelf at eye level when standing (5 feet 8 inches), creating effective psychological privacy for the seated home office desk while preserving upper sightlines and natural window light through the upper 52 inches of vertical loft space (120 - 68 = 52 inches).
  3. Verify base stability and platform depth: With a 12-inch platform depth and a broad solid hardwood base plinth spanning 68 inches, the center of gravity remains low. The weight of the kiln-dried hardwood combined with stored books provides excellent freestanding stability without requiring permanent floor bolting.

Double-check your custom commission specifications with these three final verification steps:

  • Confirm that the finished piece will navigate all doorways, elevator vestibules, and tight hallway corners during move-in day.
  • Verify that your custom finish sample matches the undertones of your existing loft hardwood flooring and cabinetry.
  • Place heavier art books on the lower two shelf tiers to optimize stability and anchor the organic silhouette.
